_comment: Threshold counts the summary block reports for large files, keyed by file type.
These are DEFINITIONS FROM THE SKILL REFERENCE FILES, restated here in a form
the code can evaluate. The reference file named in each entry's `source` is the
authority on what the number means; this file is only how the bot computes it.
Change one and you must change the other — a comment in each entry says which
Kept out of the skill .md files on purpose: those are synced byte-for-byte from
the claude.ai project by scripts/sync-skill.sh, so anything machine-readable
added to them is overwritten by the next sync.
Each group produces one count line per bucket plus its share of the rows that
have a value in `column`. Rows where the column is empty or non-numeric are
excluded from both the count and the denominator, and the block says how many
those were — a member with no `Last BIn 2 Y` is neither Active nor Lost, and
silently folding them into either bucket is how a percentage stops adding up.
`op` is one of: lte, lt, gte, gt.
